meaning: MAINLINE PLAY-state code. STATE == 0 takes the IFEQ arm and dispatches to the PLAY handler (W3MAIN.MAC:507-527). Hex 0 under W3COMN.MAC's inherited .RADIX 16.

MAINLINE PAUSE-state code. Hex 80 sets the high bit, so as a signed byte STATE < 0 and MAINLINE's IFMI (branch-on-minus) dispatches to the PAUSE handler (W3MAIN.MAC:507-527). The hex reading is forced by that sign test; decimal 80 would be positive and alias SETUP.

MAINLINE SETUP-state code. Hex 40 > 0 with the high bit clear, so STATE > 0 takes MAINLINE's ELSE arm to the SETUP handler (W3MAIN.MAC:507-527); the cold start writes it to STATE (W3MAIN.MAC:491 LDA I,S.SETU). Hex 40 under .RADIX 16.
